draft: From your apartment window in Mexico City, the streets below are filled with tension as military patrols canvass every corner. The environment is deteriorating with polluted skies and quake-prone earth. Social unrest simmers beneath the surface, with debates on resource distribution and political power. Capitalist hegemony stifles alternative economic models, leaving people struggling under debt and dependence. However, small pockets of hope can still be found in community gardens and protests against the oppressive status quo. The overall mood is one of anxiety and resignation.
